description: Up to 5 apps' keyword lists side by side in one storefront: for every term, each app's rank, how many of the apps hold it and which ones are missing. Put your own app id first to see the terms your rivals hold and you are still to win. Apps outside our index come back with `measured: false` and stay out of the count. 200 credits per app compared; an app outside our index is not charged. Part of Hive Explorer.

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (defaults to us)

ids.description: 2 to 5 App Store ids or Play package names, comma separated

name: get_keyword_gap
